stage.name: Voices Unheard
stage.description:
Hear the weeping, hear the cries, hear the echoes of the declaration that they will endure no more.
A Forgotten ■■: 
Lost behind a battered Rock Wall.
<Rock Wall> Units cannot be deployed on this tile.
Condition: 
DP no longer regenerates naturally, but starting DP is increased

miner_guerrilla.name: Miner Guerrilla
miner_guerrilla.flavourText: Resistance unit formed by miners, many of whom are still relatively young. They are not a rampaging mob: all they want to do is protect their families who are still underground.
abilities: Allied unit; recovers HP when within any Medic Operator's Attack Range

elite_infected_patrol_captain.name: Elite Infected Patrol Captain
elite_infected_patrol_captain.flavourText: A high-ranking officer tasked with hunting the Infected of Ursus. Greedy and cold-blooded. They are not a part of the army, and are generally despised by Ursus soldiers and city officials alike.
abilities: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

army_elite_crossbowman.name: Army Elite Crossbowman
army_elite_crossbowman.flavourText: Elite crossbowmen of the Ursus Army, equipped with heavy weapons that can penetrate thick armor. They typically operate in a squad with multiple mobile crossbowmen, ensuring plenty of firepower.
abilities: Cannot perform ranged attacks if allied units or <Miner Guerrillas> are nearby
Interference area decreased when under a commander's orders

army_infiltrator.name: Army Infiltrator
army_infiltrator.flavourText: Members of the Ursus Infiltrator Squad. They have already infiltrated every corner of the battlefield, waiting for a chance to strike when the main Army arrives.
abilities: Can fight 1 <Miner Guerrilla> at a time

army_veteran_shieldguard.name: Army Veteran Shieldguard
army_veteran_shieldguard.flavourText: Veteran Shieldguards of the Ursus army, responsible for defending the command headquarters. Any enemy that makes it that far will not make it past the final line of defense.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; can fight 3 <Miner Guerrillas> at a time
Takes less damage when under a commander's orders

elite_imperial_striker.name: Elite Imperial Striker
elite_imperial_striker.flavourText: The powerful, battle-tested infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction. Along with the Shieldguards, they formed the front line of the Ursus Army.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

army_senior_commander.name: Army Senior Commander
army_senior_commander.flavourText: Senior commanders of the Ursus Army. Their loyalty to Ursus is beyond doubt, signified by the emblems of nobility on their uniform.
abilities: Gives orders to Army enemies on the field
Can fight 1 <Miner Guerrilla> at a time

imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.name: Imperial Artillery Core Targeteer
imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.flavourText: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built core drone operated by artillery technicians of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery. The Ursus Artillery is a fire team that has bunkered down into the city. Though packing less firepower than naval guns, their equipment still shreds through buildings and armor with ease.

fortbreaker_mk_ii.name: Fortbreaker Mk-II
fortbreaker_mk_ii.flavourText: Next-generation war machine developed by the First Arsenal of Ursus, with increased power output and ammo capacity. The trade-off is that the pilot's escape pod was removed.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block; can fight 3 <Miner Guerrillas> at a time
Fires several rockets, dealing AoE damage
Fires more rockets when under a commander's orders
